name: al5809-20
description: Diodes AL5809-20S1-7 two-terminal 20 mA (+-5%) constant-current LED regulator, 2.5-60 V across IN-OUT, SOD-123, 0.36 W (LCSC C332295). Same family as the al5809-60; for low-current strings such as 0805 indicator-class LEDs

pins.name: IN
pins.description: current input (LED cathode side for low-side use); the unmarked end

pins.name: OUT
pins.description: current output (to GND / PWM switch); the banded end, pad 1 of the SOD-123 footprint

current.description: regulated current (SPICE units), 19-21 mA for the -20 part

metadata.rotation_note: SOD-123 band assumed to mark OUT as it does on the PowerDI-123 part (DS36625: bar = OUT); JLCPCB reel orientation unverified -- check the placement preview on the first order
